title: Rhythm section changes in Fats's group: bass and drum players
summary: Besides Autrey and Sedric, the group had Al Casey, Slick Jones on drums, and bassists Billy Taylor, Cedric Wallace and Charlie Turner.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well let's go back to the earlier part with Fats, Herman. Did the -- did the personnel of the group stay pretty much the same over the years? Didn't it? It was you, and --
Vic -- I don't mean Vic, I mean Al Casey, Slick Jones --
And who on bass? They did change quite a bit, didn't they?
The bass players changed a bit, didn't they?

Oh, they did. After -- first, what I told you was Billy Taylor (Unintelligible) he was a great man. Well, he was with Duke, and this and that and the other happened, and from there we -- I'm trying to think what other bass. I know -- I know two or three. I'm trying -- I'm trying to put them in con- cession. Charlie Turner, then before that we had Cedric Wallace, bass player.
He was with Fats. He did quite a lot
of things with Fats. Then came Charlie Turner, fat man. He did quite a lot of them, yeah. And I can't think.
